author: reek
body: Probe: the pinned-key intrinsics carry the Identity effect row, so a function with a pure signature cannot read or manipulate the device identity key. In an application quire the effect is enforced - the effectful mention cannot hide in a plain let (CDX2033) and key-status's effect is not declared in the signature (CDX2031). The owned hardware stack is quire-exempt; IdentityManager is the sanctioned exempt caller.
